file: Trilogy of zaan, khalid and issabela (1).pdf

entities.name: Zaan al-Murad
entities.description: A brilliant, tortured genius attempting to reverse death whose life is defined by tragedy and betrayal.
entities.quote: Zaan al-Murad (nickname: The Cursed Prodigy) Age: 26 Appearance: Once considered the most handsome man of his generation. Tall, sharp-jawed, with intense eyes.

entities.name: Shina Nasrin
entities.description: An abandoned woman who shared a profound, wordless love with Zaan.
entities.quote: Shina Nasrin Age: 24 Appearance: Milk-white skin, long black hair, naturally beautiful, with soft expressive features.

entities.name: Ayesha Khatoon
entities.description: A wise, partially blind woman who provided refuge to the outcasts.
entities.quote: Grandma Ayesha Full Name: Ayesha Khatoon Age: 75 Appearance: Wrinkled, aged, with a kind face. One eye fully blind, another blurry.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A young man grappling with the dark legacy of his father and his identity as a survivor.
entities.quote: Khalid. He opened the door without a word. The scene outside was one of fury.

entities.name: Imperial Institute of Advanced Sciences
entities.description: A prestigious institution in Hayrabad where Zaan and Raisa engaged in advanced studies.
entities.quote: Among the most prestigious of these institutions was The Imperial Institute of Advanced Sciences — a place where only the brightest, most privileged minds dared to enter.

entities.name: Ottoman Guards
entities.description: The military arm of the empire, enforcing imperial law through violence and fear.
entities.quote: Represent law, order, and silence. They aren’t entirely evil—but they are products of a broken empire trying to retain control.

timeline_events.title: The Resurrection Experiment
timeline_events.description: Zaan and Raisa attempt a forbidden scientific ritual to revive a corpse, resulting in Zaan's death and miraculous return.
timeline_events.quote: Zaan’s body jerked violently. His burnt chest heaved once. Twice. Then— His eyes opened.

timeline_events.title: The Slaughter at the Village
timeline_events.description: The villagers, manipulated by rumors, kill Shina and Grandma Ayesha, driving Zaan into a vengeful rage.
timeline_events.quote: The door shattered. Villagers flooded in. Torches scorched the walls. Shina backed up, terrified, as spears pointed at her womb.

timeline_events.title: Nasab's Assassination
timeline_events.description: Nasab ibn Khalil is murdered in his home by masked assassins, prompting the flight of his family.
timeline_events.quote: SHINK! A blade pierced straight through Nasab’s chest from behind. He gasped. Blood poured from his mouth.
